name: What common bedroom accessibility modifications are available?

mainEntity.name: What common bedroom accessibility modifications are available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common bedroom accessibility modifications include widening doorways for wheelchair access, installing grab bars near the bed or in en-suite bathrooms, lowering light switches and outlets, and replacing standard flooring with non-slip options. Adjustable beds, voice-activated controls for lighting or blinds, and barrier-free showers in an attached bathroom are also frequently requested to enhance independence and safety within the bedroom environment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common bedroom accessibility modifications include widening doorways, installing grab bars, lowering switches, and using non-slip flooring for improved safety and independence.
